dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
……借走我剪刀的那些陌生人。你们又回来了。
 ... The strangers who borrowed my scissors. So you have returned.

我们把金丝绞带来了……你能用这个织出布料吗？
 We brought the Golden Skein... Can you weave a fabric out of this?

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
当然可以。这本就不是难事。撕裂的、烧毁的、尚未成形的——把不完美的东西交给我，经我的手，它们都会重归完整。
 Of course. That's not the hard part, after all. Torn, burnt, unborn—bring the imperfect to me, and by my fingers they will be made whole.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
西西弗百货里的每一件衣物所用的布料，无论是被人钟爱还是被人厌弃，都始于同一根线。
 The fabric that goes into every article of clothing within the Grand Magasin, be it desired or abhorred, begins with a single thread.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
只要有线，剩下的只需一根钉子就能完成。当然，还有我的剪刀刃。
 As long as there is thread, we need only a nail to complete the rest. And my scissorblades, of course.

改衣师用身躯上的剪刀刃咔嚓一声，作为她话语的佐证。
 The Alterationist made her point with a single snap of the scissor blades on her torso.

她没有立刻接过丝绞，而是略作停顿，视线在缠绕其上的丝线上停留了片刻。
 Instead of taking the skein right away, she gave a little pause, her gaze momentarily lingering on the thread wound on it.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
……我还从未见过纯粹到如此程度的金线。
 ... I've never seen Golden Thread of such high purity before.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
虽然它是从深处纺出，但很快便能配得上更高之处。
 Though it was spun into existence from the depths, it will soon be fit for greater heights.

改衣师接过丝绞，将线绕上指尖的一瞬间，刀刃不知从何处显现——双手与剪刀顿时舞动交织，一切都活了过来。
 The instant the Alterationist takes the skein and loops its string over her fingertips, blades emerge from nowhere—and everything comes alive in an ensemble dance of hands and scissors.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
……很久以前，这里曾有过另一位主人。
 ... There used to be a different master here, long ago.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
他们对待从裂缝中生长出的金子，不是当作加工的材料，而是当作供奉的对象。
 They treated the gold that grew in the cracks not as something to be worked with, but as something to be worshipped.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
他们的目标，是在加工过程中尽可能让金子保持无瑕。因此他们悉心照料着每一缕、每一寸要纺出、披挂在这棵名叫西西弗百货的巨树上的丝线……从未有一次违逆它的纹理。
 Their goal was to keep the gold as unblemished as possible as they worked. And so they took utmost care in creating every strand, every inch of the thread they would spin and drape onto this great tree called the Grand Magasin... never once working against its grain.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
那份细致在我看来近乎宗教仪式。事实上，他们干活时甚至连呼吸都不肯——因为哪怕钉子上织错了一针，都等同于对"声音"的亵渎。
 The meticulousness appeared almost religious to me. They refused to even breathe as they worked, in fact, because a single misweave of the nail was equivalent to blaspheming against the Voice.

而你……继承了他们的位置。
 And you've... inherited their position.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
是的。他们把这里托付给我悉心照料，然后离开，去更靠近"声音"了。
 Yes. They left this place in my care and departed to grow closer to the Voice.

dataList.title:
改衣师
 Alterationist
dataList.content:
这让我回想起过去。不是什么好时光，但确实让我想起了那段日子。
 This brings me back. Not to good times, but it does bring me back.

她那双因追忆而短暂停顿的手，重新动了起来。
 Her hands, briefly stilled in reminiscence, resumed their work.
